title: Content Superengine - analysis config (superset of legacy tiers.json)
description: Per-project config for competitor-cross-reference/analyze.py. Every key beyond the tiers.json base (client, client_followers, LARGE/MED/SMALL) is OPTIONAL and defaults to the engine's built-in value, so a bare tiers.json stays on the identical code path -> the EWH regression gate cannot drift by construction. Loaded by reel_io.load_config (analysis-config.json first, else tiers.json).

title.description: H1 for analysis-data.md. Default when absent: '# @<client> - Cross-Reference Analysis Data (evidence appendix)'.

themes.description: name -> regex pattern (JSON-escaped). When absent, the engine uses its built-in EWH theme dict verbatim.

lanes.description: lane name -> [handles]. PRESENCE enables lane_on: lane column, lane rollups, theme-by-lane section, outlier lane column, theme client-median column, and the 'Client reels (all)' label. Insertion order = display order.

client_lane.description: lane tag for the client row (e.g. BLEND). Only rendered when lanes present.

hook_lexicon.description: hook-type -> extra regex alternatives appended to the base hook detector for that type (myth-bust/negation, contrarian/curiosity, pain-callout, ...). Empty/absent -> base detector unchanged.
